omar: quick signal from last night's handoff storm: a tiny fraction of evict entries become unreachable after release+retry races. memory climbs slowly. logs attached.

penny: paste the minimal trace please

omar: snippet:
[lease] release prefix=svc/pay epoch=612 -> OK
[evict] enqueue id=0x911 prefix=svc/pay owner=old-3 -> ENQUEUED
[lease] release retry prefix=svc/pay epoch=612 -> OK (retry)
[evict] enqueue id=0x911 prefix=svc/pay -> dedupe: present (no ack)
[new-owner] bind shard -> ok
[evict] dequeue id=0x911 -> lookup failed (owner-key mismatch)

syl: ack-window again. We talked options: small bounded wait on release for enqueue ack, stable global enqueue-id (prefix+uuid) with CAS, small ledger mapping enqueue-id->owner, or a gentle background reaper.

rachel: runbook wise, quick fix is release-wait 200ms behind a flag + low-rate reaper that only touches keys with >2 handoffs in 30s. Medium: owner fence + enqueue origin_epoch metadata so dequeue validates epoch. Long: stable-key migration with dual-write/backfill.

omar: agreed. Also tombstone nuance: tombstones must remove queue entries regardless of owner but must not let stale tombstones delete new data. Proposal: tombstone carries tombstone_epoch and we only apply if tombstone_epoch >= entry.origin_epoch. Add tombstone_ttl guard.

penny: implementation notes: make release-wait async with a cap (e.g., 400 concurrent waits) to avoid thread exhaustion. Reaper should emit operator events when it remaps or deletes >N entries. Add metrics: orphaned_queue_entries, release_wait_fallback_count, enqueue_cas_conflicts, reaper_actions.

syl: long-term RFC should compare cost and perf: CAS enqueue latency, index storage growth, ledger RAFT overhead, reaper scan cost. Include migration steps: dual-write window, backfill rewriter, and a short pause-enqueue cutover option. Also include chaos tests.

omar: short-term plan: canary release with release-wait=200ms + reaper at 0.5% qps, add metrics and dashboard, smoke tests for handoff storm + delayed retries. Feature flag per-cluster and rollback steps.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy started: evict-ack-window.v1 -> canary-1 at 2026-03-23T03:12:00Z

rachel: remember to add reconciliation logging (enqueue_id, origin_epoch) to correlate traces.

penny: I'll open the PR and schedule the chaos run next week. tagging reviewers. :thumbsup:
